sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Alphabet Mahjong is a tile-matching game where you match identical letter tiles to clear the board. The game starts with a simple grid of tiles, but as you progress, new tiles are added, and the game becomes increasingly complex. The objective is to remove all the tiles from the board before the time limit expires.

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet engaging, requiring players to think strategically and adapt their approach on the fly. You can move tiles around the board, swap them, or use special moves like the 'undo' button to correct mistakes. As you clear tiles, you'll earn points, and the game will reward you with power-ups, bonuses, and level unlocks.

One of the key features of Alphabet Mahjong is its emphasis on pattern recognition and spatial reasoning. Players need to identify and match identical tiles, which requires attention to detail and spatial awareness. This cognitive challenge makes the game engaging and stimulating, even for experienced players.

Alphabet Mahjong's core gameplay mechanics are easy to learn but challenging to master. The game offers a gentle learning curve, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a casual player, you'll find the gameplay engaging and addictive.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
